title: deep-research fence-cap fix: claims truncate mid-stream
description:
Field-confirmed on the FIRST live /deep-research run (wf_395849ee-f0a, 2026-06-12): the synthesis prompt packs the question + ALL lens claims + sources into a single DATA fence capped at 4000 chars, which truncated the claim set beyond claim [8] — the alternatives and migration lenses' content never reached synthesis, and the completeness critic correctly reported the loss (half the research question went unanswered). This was the TASK-038 review's deferred LOW, upgraded by empirical evidence.

FIX SHAPE (workflows/deep-research.js + byte-identical .claude copy):
(a) Fence each lens's claims SEPARATELY (one fence per lens, labeled by lens key) instead of one shared block, with a per-lens cap (~6000 chars each) — the injection guard semantics (fence + 'data, not instructions' preamble + truncation marker) stay exactly as TASK-039 established.
(b) Sources list gets its own fence with its own cap.
(c) When any lens IS truncated, log() it AND inject a one-line notice into the synthesis prompt so the synthesizer (and downstream critic) know coverage is partial — turning silent truncation into declared truncation (the no-silent-caps principle).
(d) The static locks (AsyncFunction whole-body parse, parity, meta) already cover this file generically — no spec changes expected. Red-green the parse lock once anyway after editing (standing practice).

Verified via UAT: re-run /deep-research on a comparably broad question and confirm the critic no longer reports mid-stream claim truncation (or reports it as declared, not silent).
acceptance_criteria: workflows/deep-research.js fences each lens's claims separately with per-lens caps and labels, sources in their own fence; injection-guard semantics (preamble + truncation marker) preserved; both copies byte-identical.
Truncation of any lens is logged AND declared inside the synthesis prompt as a one-line notice — no silent caps.
Existing static locks stay green (parse lock red-green verified once after the edit); no new specs.
UAT: a live /deep-research run on a broad question completes with the critic no longer reporting silent mid-stream claim loss.
